description: Update a task: close it (status=done), reassign, reprioritise, edit text/deadline/cat.

cat.description: technical | communicative | decision | chore — anything else is kept as a tag instead

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or +Nd for N days from today (UTC)

depends_on.description: task ids this task waits on

id.description: bare number or a node-scoped id like "pine-3"

tags.description: free-form labels; replaces the task's tag list

name: hub_task_update
